51294508.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant His-tagged CRM1 (unknown origin) by SPR analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods - SPR Binding Assa: SPR Binding Assay. Studies of binding kinetics were performed on a Biacore T200 (GE Healthcare). His-tagged CRM1, IkBα, and Keap1 proteins were immobilized in 0.5 mM NiCl2 on a Biacore Series S NTA chip. LFS-829 and control compound KPT-330 (10 μM) were tested in immobilization buffer supplemented with 5% (v/v) DMSO, at a flow rate of 30 μL/min, a contact time of 60 s, and a dissociation time of 300 s. A solvent correction curve from 4.5–5.8% (v/v) DMSO was included. The analysis was performed using the Biacore Evaluation software, version 3.0, using a kinetic fit and a 1:1 binding model. Representative curves were exported and replotted in GraphPad Prism.
original_paragraph.Figure 2 caption: Figure 2. CRM1 is a major cellular target of LFS-829. (A) The SPR (surface plasmon resonance) binding assay between LFS-829 and CRM1 performed on Biacore T200 with KPT-330 as a positive control (LFS-829, Kd = 26.95 nM; KPT-330, Kd = 18.74 nM). (B) The cellular activity of LFS-829 on siCRM1-HCT-15 and the wild-type HCT-15 cell line with different concentrations for 24 h. (C) The time course of CRM1-LFS829 complex degradation determined by a cell-based phenotypic nuclear export functional assay. The localization of NES-GFP per hour was monitored by confocal microscopy after cells (293T cell line) were washed with PBS to remove the compounds. Only after two hours, NES-GFP in cells incubated with LFS-829 was almost completely translocated to the cytoplasm, indicating its reverse binding.
original_paragraph.Results section - SPR binding assay: Next, we tried to evaluate the binding specificity of LFS-829 with CRM1 as compared to other possible protein targets with reactive cysteine in the binding pocket. Here, we chose IkBα and Keap1 as two control probes to investigate because both of them are reactive for covalent inhibitors and thereby frequently used for testing selectivity. Our SPR (surface plasmon resonance, Biacore T200) results revealed that LFS-829 binds strongly with CRM1 (Kd ~ 26.95 nM, Figure 2A) as compared to KPT-330 (Kd ~18.74 nM). In contrast, LFS-829 does not bind with either two control probes IkBα or Keap1 in SPR binding assay experiments.
